backend/main.mo: Main actor defining Product, Order, and ContactSubmission types with CRUD operations for products, orders, and contact form submissions, including blob storage mixin and migration support.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module defining data types (Product, Order, ContactSubmission) and a pass-through migration function that preserves existing actor state during upgrades.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting implemented admin product management features including AdminProductsPage, ProductEditModal, React Query hooks, routing, and image upload handling.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Pre-generated summaries of frontend components including routing, navigation, product display, cart management, checkout flow, admin dashboard, and styling configuration.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom OKLCH color variables for light and dark themes, defining kraft paper aesthetic with burgundy, cream, and forest green color tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Beat o Beet React application with root div and module script reference to main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component configuring TanStack Router with routes for home, checkout, order confirmation, admin dashboard, and admin products, wrapped with QueryClient, CartProvider, and Toaster.
frontend/src/components/CartSidebar.tsx: Sliding sidebar component displaying cart items with product images, quantity controls (plus/minus/input), remove buttons, total price calculation, and checkout navigation.
frontend/src/components/ContactSection.t: Contact form component with fields for name, email, address, and message that submits via useSubmitContactForm hook and displays success/error states. Includes static contact information display with email, phone, and location details.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying brand logo, quick navigation links with smooth scrolling, contact info, and copyright notice. Includes three-column grid layout with brand info, quick links, and connect section.
frontend/src/components/HealthBenefitsSe: Displays health benefits of beetroot juice in a three-column grid (circulation, energy, antioxidants) plus a nutritional highlights section listing key nutrients and their benefits. Includes scientific disclaimer note at bottom.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Full-screen hero section with background image, logo, tagline "100% Natural Vitality", product description, and CTA button that scrolls to products section. Features animated entrance effects and decorative SVG wave at bottom.
frontend/src/components/Navigation.tsx: Sticky navigation bar with logo, desktop/mobile menu, smooth scroll links to page sections, admin links, and shopping cart button with item count badge. Includes mobile menu toggle and integrates with CartSidebar component.
frontend/src/components/ProcessSection.t: Two-column section explaining the cold press juice production process in three numbered steps (sourcing, cold pressing, purity) with accompanying image. Includes highlight box explaining benefits of cold pressing over traditional methods.
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx: Displays a single product card with image, name, variant, description, benefits, price, and an 'Add to Cart' button that shows success feedback when clicked.
frontend/src/components/ProductEditModal: Modal dialog for editing product details including name, variant, price, description, benefits, image (via upload or URL), and stock status with form validation and submission.
Renders a grid of four hardcoded beetroot juice products (Pure, Apple, Ginger, Carrot variants) using ProductCard components with section header and additional info footer.
frontend/src/contexts/CartContext.tsx: React context provider managing shopping cart state (items, quantities, totals) with localStorage persistence and methods for adding, removing, updating, and clearing cart items.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and manages an ICP backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state, invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context and hooks for login/logout functionality with AuthClient integration, delegation validation, and authentication status management.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for backend operations including order submission/retrieval, contact form submission/listing, and product CRUD operations (get, update, delete).
frontend/src/hooks/useToast.ts: Simple wrapper hook around Sonner toast library providing success, error, and info notification methods.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that imports fonts (Caveat and Inter), configures Tailwind CSS, and defines custom CSS variables for a kraft paper/natural theme with burgundy, cream, and forest green colors in both light and dark modes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClient for data fetching and InternetIdentityProvider for authentication, then renders the App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboardPage.ts: Admin dashboard page that displays a sortable table of customer contact submissions with loading and error states, allowing sorting by name, email, address, and submission date.
frontend/src/pages/AdminProductsPage.tsx: Admin product management page that displays a table of products with edit and delete functionality, showing product images, names, variants, prices, and descriptions.
frontend/src/pages/CheckoutPage.tsx: Checkout page with a form for customer information (name, email, shipping address) and order submission functionality that validates inputs, submits orders, clears cart, and redirects to order confirmation.
frontend/src/pages/OrderConfirmationPage: Order confirmation page that displays order details including customer information, shipping address, order status, and a success message after successful order submission.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration file defining custom color schemes (including burgundy, brown, cream, kraft, forest themes using OKLCH color space), container settings, border radius variables, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state file documenting a cold-pressed beetroot juice e-commerce website for Mysore Food Labs (Beat o Beet brand) with features including product showcase, shopping cart, UPI payment integration, contact forms, admin dashboard, and organic/earthy design aesthetic.
